desc:
🔺Valoblox is a 5v5 tactic shooter with abilities and different guns🔺

⚠️ We realized using models was agains riot tos late so please understand that we must change the game no matter what.

⚠️Please remember this is an Alpha so please expect bugs and lack of content.⚠️

🏴Goals🏳️ (Ignore this is for the main game)

50k favourites = 2 Agents and Agent selection (soon)

20k likes👍 = Skins system  (soon)

30k likes👍 Competitive Mode

Keybinds (Doesnt support controller for now only mobile and keyboard)

Enter  Team chat
Enter+Shift  Global Chat
C,Q,E  Abilities
WASD Move
R  Reload
